verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.perplexity.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the API documentation. Docs pages are served as markdown (.md) with an embedded pointer telling agents to fetch the llms.txt index, and a machine-readable openapi.json is also available. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content variant.
